paragraphs: The XK 5.0 V8 uses the AJ133 — a 5.0-litre naturally aspirated V8 petrol engine. It was fitted from 2005 to 2014 across the X150 generation. The AJ133 is part of Jaguar's third-generation AJ-V8 family, and its timing chain tensioner design is the subject of a documented class-action lawsuit covering this exact engine across multiple JLR models. The XK 5.0 V8 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 5.0L V8 Petrol engine fitted to the XK 5.0 V8 — X150 (2005–2014).
